description: Returns the distribution of every hospital's price for a code_type/code, computed server-side: min/p10/q1/median/q3/p90/max, standard deviation, a histogram, and the real hospital nearest each percentile. Use this instead of paging through list_hospital_code_costs when you want to know how prices spread across hospitals (e.g. "is $12k high for MS-DRG 788?" - pass reference_price to get the number of hospitals priced below it). All figures are in terms of the chosen statistic (default: each hospital's average price).

bin_count.description: Number of histogram bars. Defaults to 16, capped at 200 (larger values are rejected).

code_type.description: Code system the billing code belongs to, e.g. APR-DRG, CDM, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, RC.

methodology.description: Pricing methodology. Omit to aggregate across all methodologies.

min_sample_count.description: Minimum pricing sample size: only include hospitals whose price is backed by at least this many billing records (same semantics as list_hospital_code_costs). 0 (default) disables the filter. Negative values are rejected.

reference_price.description: Optional price to place on the distribution. When positive, hospitals_below_reference counts hospitals priced strictly below it. Negative values are rejected.

statistic.description: Which per-hospital figure to distribute: each hospital's average (default), median, lowest filed price, or highest filed price.

name: get_code_price_distribution

outputSchema.description: A statistic ACROSS hospitals of one per-hospital value (the request's statistic: each hospital's average, median, min or max price). E.g. with statistic MEDIAN, `median` is the median across hospitals of each hospital's median price.

histogram_bins.description: Hospital count per equal-width bar from histogram_lo to histogram_hi; the last bar includes its upper edge.

histogram_hi.description: Upper edge of the last bar: min(max, 1.35 * p90), or min + 1 when that is not above the minimum. Hospitals priced above this are counted in overflow_count.

histogram_lo.description: Lower edge of the first histogram bar (the minimum).

hospital_count.description: Hospitals with a positive value for the code on their latest revision (and at least min_sample_count samples, if set). 0 means every other field is unset.

hospitals_below_reference.description: Hospitals priced strictly below the request's reference_price; 0 when it was not set.

max_hospital.description: A real hospital and its price for the code, used to name a hospital at a percentile. Unset (absent or empty hospital_id) when hospital_count is 0.

hospital_id.description: Opaque handle - pass back as hospital_id to other tools.

price.description: This hospital's value of the requested statistic.
